FC-16.title: Figure C-16: Angle of Internal Friction vs. Relative Density (printed C-38, PDF 152)
FC-16.legend_hint: the open circles are the only symbols on this figure
FC-16.notes_for_reviewers: Angle of internal friction from direct shear tests (degrees) against relative density Dr for RS soil (red crushed volcanic scoria). The open circles are measured friction angles; two circles joined by a short horizontal line are one angle measured over a range of Dr, and each of the two circles counts as a symbol. The solid curve runs through the middle; the two dashed curves run above and below it. The short horizontal joining lines are not curves. Circles at the right edge can be cut by the frame. On a dashed curve, a crosshair in a white gap between dashes is a no.
